glosses: settlement with a minimum of five thousand inhabitants (bigger than a town but smaller than a city) that has asked for the title officially; previously, this title was granted by the king

examples.text: Al fin llegamos a la villa.
examples.en: At last, we arrived at the village.

examples.text: Él tuvo que dejar la villa.
examples.en: He had to leave the village.

examples.text: Nuestro colegio está en esta villa.
examples.en: Our school is in this village.

examples.text: El hospital estaba muy lejos de su villa.
examples.en: The hospital was far away from his village.

examples.text: Mi tío tiene una granja en la villa.
examples.en: My uncle has a farm in the village.
